```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(reshape)
library(stringr)
library(janitor)
ftir_pigmenti <- read_excel("ftir_pigmenti_rev_3.xlsx") |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(V2 = str_remove(V2, '\\..*')) %>% 
  scrutiny::row_to_colnames(row = 1:5, collapse = "_", drop = F) %>% tibble(.name_repair = "unique") |> 
  filter(duplicated(Source_ID_Color_Luster_Slip...2) == F)

```


# Select white bandwiths

```{r}
d2 <- ftir_pigmenti |> 
    filter(Source_ID_Color_Luster_Slip...2 >= 1000 & Source_ID_Color_Luster_Slip...2 <= 1600) 

d3 <- d2 |> 
   data.table::transpose() 

rownames(d3) <- colnames(d2)

d3 <-  d3 |>  
  scrutiny::row_to_colnames(row = 1:2, collapse = "_", drop = T) |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.numeric)) |> 
  rownames_to_column(var = "full_info") |> 
  separate(col = full_info, into = c("source","id", "color", "luster", "slip"), sep = "_", remove = F) |> 
   mutate(slip = str_remove_all(slip, "\\.\\.\\.\\d+")) |> 
  rownames_to_column(var = "ID") |> 
  unite("rowname", "ID", "id", "slip", remove = F) |> 
  column_to_rownames("rowname")

```


# FTIR pre-processing

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# FTIR pre‑processing robustness assessment
# ---------------------------
# Assumes the data frame 'd3' already exists, with metadata columns 1-7 
# and spectral columns starting at column 8 (wavenumbers 1000–1600 cm⁻¹).
# The variable 'wavenumbers' contains the numeric labels of those columns.

library(prospectr)   # standardNormalVariate, savitzkyGolay
library(clValid)     # cluster validation
library(dplyr)

# Extract pure spectral matrix (samples × wavenumbers)
spec_data <- d3[, 8:ncol(d3)]   # adjust indices if needed

# 1. Baseline correction using the rubber-band method
#    (requires the 'baseline' package)
library(baseline)
# List of spectra as a matrix (rows = samples, cols = wavenumbers)
spec_mat <- as.matrix(spec_data)
spec_bl <- baseline(spec_mat)
spec_bl <- getCorrected(spec_bl)

# 2. SNV (Standard Normal Variate) – on raw, baseline‑corrected, and derivative data
spec_SNV_raw       <- prospectr::standardNormalVariate(spec_mat)
spec_SNV_bl        <- prospectr::standardNormalVariate(spec_bl)

# 3. Savitzky–Golay 1st derivative (2nd order polynomial, 11‑point window)
#    applied after baseline correction + SNV (recommended pipeline)
spec_d1 <- prospectr::savitzkyGolay(spec_SNV_bl, p = 2, w = 11, m = 1)

# ---------- Define the four pre‑processing variants ----------
preproc_list <- list(
  "Raw + scale" = scale(spec_mat),              # original approach
  "Baseline + scale" = scale(spec_bl),
  "SNV (no deriv.)" = spec_SNV_bl,                  # SNV normalised, no further scaling
  "SNV + 1st derivative" = scale(spec_d1)                # scaling optional but harmless
)

# ---------- Cluster validation for each variant ----------
valid_res <- vector("list", length(preproc_list))
names(valid_res) <- names(preproc_list)

for (i in seq_along(preproc_list)) {
  X <- preproc_list[[i]]
  d <- dist(X, method = "euclidean")
  d <- as.matrix(d)
  valid_res[[i]] <- clValid(d, nClust = 2:6, clMethods = "agnes",
                            validation = c("internal", "stability"))
}

# Print summaries – optimal k per variant
for (nm in names(preproc_list)) {
  cat("\n", nm, "\n")
  print(summary(valid_res[[nm]]))
}

```


# Hierarchical Clustering

```{r}
library(factoextra)
library(FactoMineR)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(writexl)
library(patchwork)
library(clValid)

spec_preproc <- as.data.frame(spec_d1) |> 
  rownames_to_column("rows") |> 
  rownames_to_column("ID")

df_scumm <- left_join(spec_preproc, d3[, 1:7], by = "ID") |> 
  relocate(where(is.character)) |> 
  unite("rowname", "ID", "id", "luster", "slip", remove = F) |> 
  column_to_rownames("rowname") |> 
  select(-"rows")
  

dist_mat_scumm <- get_dist(df_scumm[, 8:ncol(df_scumm)], method = "minkowski")

h_clusts_scumm <- hclust(dist_mat_scumm, method = "ward.D2")  
plot(h_clusts_scumm)
 

clust <- cutree(h_clusts_scumm, k = 2)
df_scumm$clusters <- clust

pca_res_2 <- PCA(df_scumm[,-c(1:7, 139)], scale.unit = F,
                    graph = F
                 )
fviz_pca_biplot(pca_res_2, 
                habillage = df_scumm$clusters,
                invisible = "var"
                ) 

pca_2_df <- pca_res_2$ind$coord |> as.data.frame() |> 
  as_tibble() |>
  rownames_to_column(var = "ID")

d_sum_2 <- df_scumm %>% 
  full_join(pca_2_df) |> 
  rownames_to_column() |> 
  unite(col = rowname, c(1,2,3,4,5,6), remove = FALSE) |> 
  column_to_rownames(var = "rowname") |> 
  mutate(clusters = as.factor(clusters)) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

summary_df_scumm <- d_sum_2 |> 
  group_by(clusters) |> 
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    blank = sum(color == "blank"),
    red = sum(color == "red"),
    black = sum(color == "black"),
    white = sum(color == "white"),
    brown = sum(color == "brown"),
    Fe_Mn = sum(color == "Fe&Mn"),
    w_luster = sum(luster == "w/Luster"),
    wo_luster = sum(luster == "w/o Luster"),
    tablets = sum(source == "Tablets"),
    clays = sum(source == "Clays"),
    pigments = sum(source == "Pigments"),
    arch = sum(source == "Arch"),
    w_slip = sum(slip == "slip"),
    wo_slip = sum(slip == "w/o"),
    scumming = sum(slip == "scumming")
  ) |> 
  t() |> #transpose
  as.data.frame() |> 
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)

summary_df_scumm

d_sum_2 |> count(clusters)

d_sum_2 |> group_by(clusters) |> 
  count(source,color, sort = T) |> 
  arrange(clusters) |>
  print(n = 29)

d_sum_2 |> group_by(clusters) |> 
  count(slip, luster, sort = T) |> 
  arrange(clusters, slip) |>
  print(n = 40) 

d_sum_2 |> 
  group_by(clusters) |> 
  count(luster, sort = TRUE) |> 
  arrange(clusters, luster) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = clusters, y = n, 
             fill = interaction(luster))) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +   # or "stack" depending on desired look
  labs(x = "Cluster", 
       y = "Count", 
       fill = "Legend") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = T)

d_sum_2 |> 
  group_by(clusters) |> 
  count(slip, sort = TRUE) |> 
  arrange(clusters, slip) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = clusters, y = n, 
             fill = interaction(slip))) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +   # or "stack" depending on desired look
  labs(x = "Cluster", 
       y = "Count", 
       fill = "Legend") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = T)

d_sum_2 |> 
  group_by(clusters) |> 
  count(color, sort = TRUE) |> 
  arrange(clusters, color) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = clusters, y = n, 
             fill = interaction(color))) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +   # or "stack" depending on desired look
  labs(x = "Cluster", 
       y = "Count", 
       fill = "Legend") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = T)

d_sum_2 |> 
  group_by(clusters) |> 
  count(slip, luster, color, sort = TRUE) |> 
  arrange(clusters) |> 
  # Create a single label that identifies each bar uniquely
  mutate(bar_label = paste(clusters, slip, luster, color, sep = " | ")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = bar_label, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 65, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Cluster | slip | lustre | color", y = "Count")

d_sum_2 |> group_by(clusters) |> 
  count(slip,luster, sort = T) |> 
  arrange(clusters)

```



######PCA - visualisations - eigen values


```{r}
eigen_values <- pca_res_2$eig |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  rownames_to_column() |> 
    janitor::clean_names() |> 
  arrange(desc(percentage_of_variance)) 


graph_eigen <- eigen_values |> 
    top_n(8, percentage_of_variance) |>
  mutate(percentage_of_variance = round(percentage_of_variance, 2)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(rowname, percentage_of_variance)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = percentage_of_variance, 
                vjust = 1.5)
            ) +
  xlab(label = "Principal Components") +
  ylab(label = "Percentage of variation explained") +
  labs(title = "...")
graph_eigen
```

contrib_var_selection <- pca_res_2$var$contrib |>

cors_var <- pca_res_2$var$cor |>

graph_dim1_cors <-

######PCA - visualisations - cases

```{r}
coord_ind <- 
  pca_res_2$ind$coord |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  mutate_if(is.character, as.factor) |> 
  rownames_to_column() |> 
  as_tibble()
  

graph_ind_1 <- coord_ind |> 
  mutate(rowname = fct_reorder(rowname, Dim.1, .desc = T)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(Dim.1, rowname)) +
  geom_col(aes(colour = as.factor(df_scumm$clusters), fill = as.factor(df_scumm$clusters))) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(1,1),
    legend.justification.inside = c(1,1),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) + 
  xlab(label =  "...") + 
  ylab(label =  "...") +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = T) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "clusters")) +
  guides(color = F)

```

# Verification: bandwiths from 600-700

```{r}
d_verif <- ftir_pigmenti |> 
    filter(Source_ID_Color_Luster_Slip...2 >= 600 & Source_ID_Color_Luster_Slip...2 <= 700) 

d_veriff <- d_verif |> 
   data.table::transpose() 

rownames(d_veriff) <- colnames(d_verif)

d_veriff <- d_veriff |>  
  scrutiny::row_to_colnames(row = 1:2, collapse = "_", drop = T) |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.numeric)) |> 
  rownames_to_column(var = "full_info") |> 
  separate(col = full_info, into = c("source","id", "color", "luster", "slip"), sep = "_", remove = F) |> 
   mutate(slip = str_remove_all(slip, "\\.\\.\\.\\d+")) |> 
  rownames_to_column(var = "ID") |> 
  unite("rowname", "ID", "id", "slip", remove = F) |> 
  column_to_rownames(var = "rowname")

spec_data_2 <- d_veriff[, 8:ncol(d_veriff)]   # adjust indices if needed

# 1. Baseline correction using the rubber-band method
#    (requires the 'baseline' package)
library(baseline)
# List of spectra as a matrix (rows = samples, cols = wavenumbers)
spec_mat_2 <- as.matrix(spec_data_2)
spec_bl_2 <- baseline(spec_mat_2)
spec_bl_2 <- getCorrected(spec_bl_2)

# 2. SNV (Standard Normal Variate) – on raw, baseline‑corrected, and derivative data
spec_SNV_raw_2 <- prospectr::standardNormalVariate(spec_mat_2)
spec_SNV_bl_2 <- prospectr::standardNormalVariate(spec_bl_2)

# 3. Savitzky–Golay 1st derivative (2nd order polynomial, 11‑point window)
#    applied after baseline correction + SNV (recommended pipeline)
spec_d3 <- prospectr::savitzkyGolay(spec_SNV_bl_2, p = 2, w = 11, m = 1)

# ---------- Define the four pre‑processing variants ----------
preproc_list_2 <- list(
  "Raw + scale" = scale(spec_mat_2),              # original approach
  "Baseline + scale" = scale(spec_bl_2),
  "SNV (no deriv.)" = spec_SNV_bl_2,                  # SNV normalised, no further scaling
  "SNV + 1st derivative"   = scale(spec_d3)                # scaling optional but harmless
)

# ---------- Cluster validation for each variant ----------
valid_res_2 <- vector("list", length(preproc_list_2))
names(valid_res_2) <- names(preproc_list_2)

for (i in seq_along(preproc_list_2)) {
  X <- preproc_list_2[[i]]
  d <- dist(X, method = "euclidean")
  d <- as.matrix(d)
  valid_res[[i]] <- clValid(d, nClust = 2:6, clMethods = "agnes",
                            validation = c("internal", "stability"))
}

# Print summaries – optimal k per variant
for (nm in names(preproc_list_2)) {
  cat("\n", nm, "\n")
  print(summary(valid_res[[nm]]))
}
```
